title: A Confession for the Ledger
author: Jonah Reyes
blurb: Emrys Eriksen, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
